honesty_boundary: All Pythagorean identities a^2 + b^2 = c^2 are classical and exact.  The substrate-primitive identifications of each (a, b, c) entry are exact arithmetic. ogg_prime_hypotenuses.comment: THREE of the 15 Monster supersingular Ogg primes (17, 29, 41) appear as hypotenuses of substrate Pythagorean triples.  This is a striking bridge between Monster moonshine and elementary Pythagorean number theory.

pythagorean_triples_with_substrate.klein_link: All three substrate primitives are Klein-quartic-relevant

theorem: W(3,3) Pythagorean Triple Package Theorem.  ELEVEN primitive Pythagorean triples have ALL THREE entries (a, b, c) in substrate-primitive form: (3,4,5), (5,12,13), (7,24,25), (8,15,17), (9,40,41), (12,35,37), (16,63,65), (20,21,29), (33,56,65), (48,55,73), (13,84,85).  Each provides an exact a^2 + b^2 = c^2 substrate identity.  THREE Monster-Ogg supersingular primes (17, 29, 41) appear as hypotenuses, bridging Monster moonshine to elementary Pythagorean number theory.  The triple (33, 56, 65) places three Klein-quartic-relevant primitives in one identity.  The triple (13, 84, 85) bridges q = 3 substrate to the next-q vertex count v(GQ(4,4)). The triple (48, 55, 73) places the 12th cyclotomic Phi_12 as a Pythagorean hypotenuse.  The (3, 4, 5) triple alone FORCES q = 3 (commit 6068e0ad).
